note: Fails if docs_related stops answering a register with every document linked to it or its tables and variables (one row per link, whole-document page 0 and the page of each subject), loses the row fields, or misorders the rows by title, hash and page; or if a table or a variable stops answering its own links only; or answers an unknown ref other than not_found, a ref outside the public-id grammar other than invalid_ref, or ignores an unknown parameter instead of refusing it.
